description: MCUT campus electricity sub-metering dataset (one year, 15-minute, three-phase), published by Luo, Ching-Chuan, records building and circuit electricity measurements across two university campuses. Coverage: 234 meters across 15 buildings on two Ming Chi University of Technology campuses in New Taipei City, plus rooftop PV, 6 July 2025 to 5 July 2026. The repository supplies a public deposit and file listing. Only metadata was read; the files, schemas and calculations were not executed or checked. The deposit is marked cc-by-4.0. Its public landing page and listed open files are available without a login; upstream source conditions may also apply. Limitations: This is one university estate with a specific metering and semantic setup. Record counts, completeness and SHACL results were not independently checked. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
